The SQL workbench uses this route to return a tabular query result. Runtime callability is narrower than the upstream endpoint: only a locally parsed, single SELECT/WITH statement with exact relation, function, output, and resource policy may reach the route.

static_control_flow.detail: The production base builder selects https://api-insight.gravity-engine.com and appends /custom_sql. The query function then calls the shared fetch wrapper with /api/sql/execute, method POST, and JSON.stringify(request).

The SQL-page execution handler constructs exactly {sql, tabId}, passes it to the query function, and renders the returned tabular result. Cancellation, formatting, history, export, and template persistence use separate paths.

The response normalizer consumes result.columns and result.rows; column objects may expose name or columnName and optional type, dataType, or columnType. The caller separately consumes status/state/error plus rowCount and elapsedMs.
